strategies.name: naive
strategies.note: A few Thorns beside the straight route. Upgrades when affordable. No farm.

strategies.name: maze
strategies.note: Serpentine hedge walls with Thorn, Sap and Sunstone in the wall. Buys wood and rock so it can upgrade.

strategies.name: maze-deep
strategies.note: The maze plan plus the full garden from stage 5, the only way a Sunstone can reach level 3.

strategies.name: farm-first
strategies.note: Wood then rock then iron then diamond, fully upgraded, before any tower is bought.

strategies.name: farm-lite
strategies.note: Two Thorns first, then the wood and rock plots, then the maze. Farming without going undefended.

strategies.name: reach-maze
strategies.note: The maze plan with the reach upgrade branch instead of power. Shows what the damage cap costs.

strategies.name: kit-maze
strategies.note: The r2 maze: the same walls and slots, but with two Embers and a Lantern. No abilities.
